proposals.proposed: Prefers inspectable, auditable systems — chooses approaches where every layer can be understood and verified, over frameworks that hide complexity behind abstractions.
evidence: 2026-05-14: Rejected LangChain in favor of direct Anthropic SDK — 'LangChain hides too much of what's actually being sent'
2026-05-14: Chose markdown over database for proposals file — 'stays human-readable and auditable in git without tooling'
2026-05-14: Rejected pre-built memory frameworks (MemGPT) — 'prefer to understand and own every layer'
2026-05-14: Rejected auto-approval for identity proposals — 'want a manual review gate'
